ports.note: Two tables in, one out: the rows of the second under the first, columns lined up by name. Both must have the same value column and unit; a key column only one has is empty on the other's rows.

ontology.note: No ontology mapping yet. The receipt names how many rows came from each table and every column only one of them has.

changes.description: The columns a table lacks are named in one sentence per table, not one sentence per column: eleven zonal statistics, each said apart for the census table that had none of them, made a paragraph.

evidence.note: Unit tested on columns both, one and neither table hold, different value columns and units, and a source column that clashes. The Salmonella example uses it to stack 32 cases on 81 matched panel controls. Nothing here establishes that two tables are fit to be stacked. 0.2.1: tests/append-rows.test.mjs; tests/population-example-opens.browser.mjs; Chromium.
